[{"type":"GeneralText","content":"

Thank you for your interest in Sacramento State!


This articulation agreement displays the lower-division courses required in the major: Sacramento State course son the left and approved (articulated) transfer courses on the right. Any upper-division courses included in this agreement will receive lower-division subject credit only. Although completion of the coursework listed below is not mandatory prior to admission, students are advised to complete as much lower-division course preparation as possible prior to transfer.


Additional Resources:

  • See the University Catalog for the full listing of degree requirements for this major.
  • Visit our Sac State Apply page for more information about our campus!
  • Visit the Admissions website for current transfer admission requirements.
  • Connect with an Admissions Counselor.

  2.   3. For Child and Adolescent Development advising, please contact the department at (916) 278-6639.
  4. For additional information, please visit: Child and Adolescent Development.
